title: PLAYER 2 FEELS THE OVERSEER CHANGE PHASE
why: When THE OVERSEER changes phase the host window shakes (shake 6), plays the alarm and says the phase line. Player 2 heard the alarm (it comes over as a sound) and saw the line, but his window never shook: the phase mark handler only said the line. Proven in a staged pair: the phase mark fed to player 2 window through netOnMsg says the line and leaves shake at 0. Now the same handler also shakes his window by 6, like the host. No sound is added, so the alarm is not heard twice.
now: In co-op, when THE OVERSEER changes phase, player 2s screen shakes too, just like player 1s.

edits.anchor: if(k==='phase'){ if(!G.sim) say(ovPhaseLine(m.n|0),'warn'); return 'mark:phase'; }   // v26.xx (ai24): the Overseer changed phase, said to the whole party
edits.replacement: if(k==='phase'){ if(!G.sim){ say(ovPhaseLine(m.n|0),'warn'); G.shake=Math.max(G.shake||0,6); } return 'mark:phase'; }   // v26.xx (ai24): the Overseer changed phase, said to the whole party   // v28.xx (cw-ovshake), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: player 2 feels the same shake the host does (the alarm already comes over as a sound)
